name: CP/M 3
description: CP/M Plus, non-banked: about 53K for programs, drives A: to D: and I:. Boots from this disk in A:. Press ^C or reset: the loader starts. GEN.SUB rebuilds CPM3.SYS from BIOS3.ASM.
credit: CP/M 3 by Digital Research, free under the DRDOS, Inc. licence (the build with the year 2000 fixes is John Elliott's); the BIOS, loader and boot sector are DigitalRerun's, MIT. DSTAT80 (disk status, 2015), LS and SURVEY (system survey, 1982) are small free utilities added to the disk.
